source.title: Chevrolet 2027 Equinox — Performance & Capability
source.scope: Reviewed 2027 U.S. manufacturer model page; Performance & Capability section. Equipment still uses the workbook matrix.

researchNotes: Manufacturer model page states a properly equipped model-wide maximum of 1,500 lb towing, without resolving the configuration-specific limits in the reviewed material. Configuration tow ratings remain Unverified.
The workbook and reviewed public pages do not establish configuration-specific EPA fuel economy, ground clearance, passenger volume or MSRP. No prior-year values or AWD price increment are inferred.
